name: No EasyEffects
description: Removes the EasyEffects integration from Ambxst: the Effects panel and its search entry leave the Settings tab, and the background service daemon the shell's backend auto-spawns at startup is terminated. EasyEffects is not uninstalled.
author: EliasLd
permissions: Removes the EasyEffects entry and panel from the Settings tab
Terminates the EasyEffects background service daemon shortly after shell start
